name: DNA Extraction
description: Silica column-based genomic DNA extraction from cells or tissue. Compatible with commercial kits such as Qiagen DNeasy, Thermo Fisher PureLink, and equivalents. Adjust lysis conditions based on sample type.
source_note: General educational template for silica-membrane column-based DNA extraction.

steps.title: Sample preparation and lysis
steps.description: Pellet cells by centrifugation (or use fresh tissue ~25 mg). Resuspend in lysis buffer with proteinase K. Incubate at 56°C until complete lysis (tissue requires longer incubation). Vortex periodically.
equipment: Heat block or water bath at 56°C
steps.notes: Tissue samples may require longer lysis (up to 3 h or overnight at 56°C). Cell pellets typically lyse within 30 min.
steps.warnings: Proteinase K is an irritant. Wear gloves.

steps.title: Add ethanol to lysate
steps.description: Briefly centrifuge to remove debris. Transfer lysate to a clean tube. Add 96–100% ethanol to the cleared lysate and mix thoroughly by pulse-vortexing.
steps.centrifugeCondition: Briefly spin 6000 × g to pellet debris
steps.notes: A white precipitate may form upon ethanol addition — this is normal. Mix by pipetting if needed.

steps.title: Bind DNA to spin column
steps.description: Transfer the full lysate+ethanol mixture to the spin column (including any precipitate). Centrifuge to bind DNA to the silica membrane. Discard flow-through.
steps.notes: If volume > column capacity, repeat centrifuge with remaining lysate.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW1 (or equivalent wash buffer 1)
steps.description: Add the first wash buffer to the column and centrifuge. Discard flow-through and collection tube.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer AW2 (or equivalent wash buffer 2)
steps.description: Add the second wash buffer (ethanol-containing) to the column and centrifuge. Discard flow-through.
steps.notes: This high-speed spin fully removes residual ethanol.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.description: Transfer column to a clean 1.5 mL elution tube. Add pre-warmed elution buffer (or TE/nuclease-free water) directly onto the silica membrane. Incubate briefly, then centrifuge to elute DNA.

reagents.name: Elution buffer (Buffer EB, TE, or nuclease-free water)

steps.notes: Eluting with smaller volume (50 µL) gives higher concentration. Eluting twice with 50 µL gives higher total yield.

steps.title: Quantify and assess DNA quality
steps.description: Measure DNA concentration and purity using a spectrophotometer (NanoDrop or equivalent). Check A260/A280 ratio (expected ~1.8 for pure DNA) and A260/A230 (expected 2.0–2.2).
steps.notes: Low A260/A280 (<1.7) indicates protein contamination. Low A260/A230 (<1.5) indicates solvent/salt contamination.
